title: A birodalom felbomlása és az összeomlás (A Monarchy Ends)
grammar: Past Conditional Volna in Historical Context, War Obligation & Epochal Connectors

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe how the Monarchy broke up at the end of 1918.
I can say what would not have happened otherwise at the end of the war, using volna.
I can use the words for the collapse, the demarcation line and national self-determination.
I can read a short account of the end of the war in Hungary and answer questions about it.
